crossRefs.note: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
“But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire?…
He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands…
and will cut him in pieces, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of…
If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood…
Therefore, because you trample on the poor, and take taxes from him of wheat: You have built houses of cut stone, but…
For I know how many your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who…

translations.web: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
translations.bsb: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
translations.kjv: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
translations.asv: For the company of the godless shall be barren, And fire shall consume the tents of bribery.
